summary: Independent review of the clock-roll owner safety-gate controls. TESTS ONLY (+41/-0, one file); no runtime behaviour changes. THE GAP WAS MEASURED BY ME AGAINST THE FULL SUITE, NOT INFERRED: dropping 'if not self._flip_owner_evidence_fresh(state):' left 46 failed/3605 passed UNCHANGED, and dropping 'elif state.flip_owner_open_positions:' also left 46 failed/3605 passed UNCHANGED — both safety branches of the 04:00 owner handling could be DELETED with the entire suite green. codex-2 reproduced both independently. WHY IT MATTERED MORE AFTER #948: that PR deliberately routes MORE symbols through those two gates. Before it, a silent symbol never reached them because the live-bar guard turned the whole block away; afterwards every silent symbol in the clock sweep arrives at exactly these branches, which are the only thing between the sweep and retiring an owner that still holds a position or whose evidence is stale. I VERIFIED BOTH NEW CONTROLS CAN COME OUT FALSE, one-to-one: removing the fresh-evidence gate fails ONLY test_time_roll_keeps_owner_unknown_when_position_evidence_is_stale, and removing the open-positions gate fails ONLY test_time_roll_waits_for_an_open_owned_position_to_close. Reinstating the #948 bug (sweep passing owner_boundary_is_current=False) fails all three roll tests, so the new controls also backstop the fix that motivated them. Each control asserts the SAFETY PROPERTY directly rather than a field value: identity_writes == [] proves the opportunity was NOT retired, plus the owner write reason and the preserved opportunity_id 123. All mutations anchor-checked and py_compiled; worktree verified clean after. Controlled full unit pair: base 1940d46 is TREE-IDENTICAL to dcdacf9 which I had already measured — base 46 failed/3605 passed, head 46 failed/3607 passed, ZERO new failure names and ZERO fixed. Ruff clean. Ancestor test PASS. Reviewer differs from the author. No findings; nothing withheld. ⭐ Kept as a SEPARATE PR from #949 deliberately: different subsystem (V2 session ownership vs OMS exit classification), so one PR's controls are not hostage to the other's review.
